annotations.title: Find detox and addiction treatment programs

description: Programs listed in SAMHSA FindTreatment.gov and its opioid treatment program directory, near a ZIP code (closest first, straight-line miles) or in a state or city, for one level of care: detox, residential, outpatient, methadone clinics or buprenorphine. Each result: name, address, phone, detox setting and substances, other care settings, payment accepted, an id for get_program and its withdrawal.help page. Filters for detox substance and payment.

city.description: City within state, e.g. "Columbus". Needs state.

detox_for.description: With level detox only: programs that list detox for this substance.

level.description: Level of care: detox (medically supervised withdrawal), residential, outpatient, methadone (federally certified opioid treatment programs) or buprenorphine (programs that prescribe it). Default detox.

limit.description: Results per page (1 to 10); page further with offset.

payment.description: Only programs that report accepting this payment. "medicaid" means some Medicaid plans; ask about a specific plan by name.

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. OH, when searching a state or city instead of a ZIP.

zip.description: Five-digit US ZIP code, e.g. 85004. Give this, or state.

name: find_programs
title: Find detox and addiction treatment programs
